related_questions.question: What is the life expectancy of a person with breast cancer?
related_questions.snippet: The NCI reports that 90.8% of women with breast cancer survive for 5 years after diagnosis. This survival rate includes all women with breast cancer, regardless of the stage. The 5-year relative survival rate for women with localized breast cancer at the time of diagnosis is about 99%.
related_questions.title: All About Breast Cancer Survival Rates and Outlook - Healthline

related_questions.question: What do cancer patients need most?

text_blocks.snippet: Cancer patients need a combination of practical, emotional, and informational support. This includes information about their diagnosis and treatment, emotional support to cope with the challenges of cancer, practical help with daily tasks and appointments, and financial assistance when needed.
snippet_highlighted_words: a combination of practical, emotional, and informational support

list.title: Information:
list.snippet: Patients need clear and accurate information about their specific cancer type, stage, and treatment options. They also need to understand potential side effects and what to expect during and after treatment.

list.title: Emotional Support:
list.snippet: Cancer can be emotionally draining. Patients need to feel supported, understood, and not alone. This can come from friends, family, or support groups.

list.title: Practical Help:
list.snippet: Practical assistance can range from rides to appointments, help with childcare, meal preparation, and household chores.

list.title: Financial Assistance:
list.snippet: Cancer treatment can be expensive. Patients may need help with medical bills, transportation, or other expenses.

list.title: Comfort and Self-Care:
list.snippet: Simple comforts like soft clothing, comfortable bedding, and personal care items can make a big difference in a patient's well-being.

list.title: Coping Strategies:
list.snippet: Patients can benefit from learning coping mechanisms for managing stress, anxiety, and other side effects of treatment.

list.title: Healthy Lifestyle:
list.snippet: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle with proper nutrition and exercise can play a crucial role in recovery.

list.title: Palliative Care:
list.snippet: For patients with advanced cancer, palliative care focuses on improving quality of life by managing pain and other symptoms.
